//: Scene-synced, self-verifying demo of ANY app. Each scene has `say` (spoken while it plays), `steps` (browser actions), and `expect` (the post-condition that proves the action worked — asserted at record time, so a failed click can't produce a lying video). After rendering, a vision model checks each frame against its line. Rehearse first: `node driver.mjs <config> --rehearse` runs every step and assertion headlessly in seconds.
//capture: fullScreen records the whole display. Prefer it when the demo switches tabs or shows the menu bar; a cropped rectangle frames a slice of whatever desktop is behind the window, which reads as an accident. `viewport` still positions/sizes the browser window either way.
//auth: For an app behind a login: sign in ONCE into a reusable profile, then point userDataDir at it, so no credentials are typed on camera and no hosted login page has to be automated mid-take. Sessions expire — re-run signin when a prewarm lands on a login page.  node driver.mjs signin <url> --profile .profiles/myapp [--email … --password …]
//prewarm: URLs visited BEFORE recording starts. Hosted auth redirects and cold pages paint late, and on camera that looks like a sign-in screen or a blank flash. Warming them off-camera means the scene that shows a page gets it already loaded and authenticated.
//input: osClick and osType send input through the RUNNING DemoTape app, which holds the Accessibility grant. This is what makes the auto-zoom work: DemoTape zooms on real clicks and holds on the focused field while keys arrive. Browser-level input is invisible to it, so with these off you get a technically-correct video that never zooms. Leave them on.
//motion: moveMs is how long the cursor takes to travel (eased, slightly arced, with a small overshoot). The travel is what carries the viewer's eye between two points, so don't set it to zero. typeMs is the mean ms per character for `type` steps.
//actionLeadFraction: How far into a spoken line its click/typing fires, so the words land on the action instead of trailing it.
//voice: ElevenLabs voice id; "" uses the default. List them with: DemoTape --voices. To change the voice later WITHOUT re-recording: node driver.mjs revoice <recording-folder> <voiceId>

scenes.say: Okay, let me show you around real quick. This is the Playwright site.

scenes.//: Click the exact element the line is about: DemoTape zooms where you click, so clicking a page heading puts the zoom on the top of the page and tells the viewer nothing.
scenes.say: First thing I'll do is jump into the docs, so I'll click Get started up here.

scenes.//: `type` types character by character like a person; `fill` pastes instantly (use it for setup fields nobody watches). `aimX` is where in the field to click — near the left, where the caret and first word are, so the sentence grows INTO frame rather than off its left edge.
scenes.say: Let me search the docs for locators.
And now let me scroll down a bit, so you can see how the guide is laid out.
And that's the quick tour. You point, you click, you read — and you're up and running.
